Quantum 1.2.1 was certified on 2026-07-12. It pins **nucleus v1.1.0**, **quark v1.2.1** and **orbit v1.2.0**.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.2.0: quark goes from v1.2.0 to v1.2.1 (patch), nucleus stays at v1.1.0 and orbit stays at v1.2.0.
